Reading the table: **same-URL passes every cell in Chromium (24 of 24 builds) and in WebKit except one row, the Material build that still links Google Fonts: it stalls in WebKit in every model and also with no SW at all (control run: `load` never fired in 25 s), because the third-party stylesheet request hangs in this environment; the same site passes with `font: false` and in Chromium.** Prefix passes all three checks for 5 of the 15 root-mounted builds (SvelteKit, Hugo `relativeURLs`, both MkDocs rows, Docusaurus hash router) and for 0 of the 9 sub-path builds. The 5 `PFP` rows are static generators whose HTML renders but whose every root-absolute link loads a nested shell. Remap passes 10 of 15 root-mounted builds in Chromium and 0 of 9 sub-path builds; in WebKit three remap cells differ from Chromium (Docusaurus home, Eleventy and Hugo navigation), not investigated.
